scope: Only the 80 S1/S3 primary CPR runs in both regimes, all 20 planned seeds; no full 760-run integrity audit repeated, no simulation or source import.

definitions.physical_source_stage: TX sender equals scheduled source. Unmarked DATA is R_INITIAL, unmarked FLOOD is F_INITIAL, DATA marker1 is R_REPEAT, FLOOD marker2 is F_RECOVERY. Each is joined to a started request within the frozen cutoff.
definitions.accepted_ACK_hops: len(reverse_path)-1 for accepted ACK records, joined to the actual decoded ACK RX/TX and scheduled source/destination; distributions retain each seed and initial decision mode.
definitions.intended_hop_opportunity: DATA/RREP path[path_index+1] or ACK path[path_index], matched to receiver. Broadcast/FLOOD listener outcomes are not designated hops. These are correlated receiver opportunities, not independent flows or a unique causal failure attribution.
definitions.queue_wait: All recorded non-null request queue_wait_s; means and linearly interpolated p50/p95 are per run. Aggregate means are equal-seed means, not pooled requests.
definitions.source_state_capacity_refusal: decision action events with reason state-capacity-drop, reconciled to the same reason in initial flow rows; distinct from relay state-eviction.
definitions.protocol_rejection: Request status protocol-no-start; decision action/reason combinations are separately retained and do not all mean deadline infeasibility.
definitions.ACK_cancel: cpr-cancel events reconciled to canceled=true cpr-cancel-check events. Decoded check count includes ineligible checks and is not an eligible-opportunity denominator.

limitations: Default and matched CPR are reported independently but are not extra independent seeds; never pool them as n=40.
Passing an exposure gate supports examining the mechanism, not a positive causal benefit or superiority claim.
Source-state refusal and relay-ledger eviction are different populations; zero eviction does not establish peak occupancy below capacity. Exact peak ledger occupancy is not observed.
S1/S3 is a two-point offered-load comparison, not a saturation threshold. Zero or adverse rows remain included.
S2 and its reference component exposure are reviewed separately by the parent; this file does not certify those outcomes or the entire formal batch.
